title: RCMDM 5th Regular Meeting RY 2026-27
summary: The 5th regular meeting of RCMDM was held at residence of Rtns. Bharti and Dilip Gurjar at Bhimrao wadi, Thakurdwar, Mumbai, from 3.15pm onwards. VP Dr. Sanjay called the meeting to order, led the National Anthem and conducted the meeting.
description: The 5th regular meeting of RCMDM was held at residence of Rtns. Bharti and Dilip Gurjar at Bhimrao wadi, Thakurdwar, Mumbai, from 3.15pm onwards. VP Dr. Sanjay called the meeting to order, led the National Anthem and conducted the meeting. Apart from discussions on various projects undertaken, proposed and lined out, detailed discussion and deliberation and planning was held and done for the Annual Elocution Contest to be held at Brahman Sabha, Prarthana Samaj in either October or November 2026. Topics, timings, budget, judges, schools etc. were deliberated and a rough plan drawn out. Meeting concluded with high tea and snacks hosted by Gurjar family.
